groups.name: Phnom Penh
groups.mnemonic: Phone Pay — how Phnom Penh sounds

places.name: Jakarta
places.significance: Current capital of Indonesia, on the island of Java

places.name: Nusantara
places.significance: Indonesia's planned future capital, under construction on Borneo (East Kalimantan)

places.name: Sumatra
places.significance: Westernmost of the Greater Sunda Islands, facing the Strait of Malacca

places.name: Java
places.significance: Indonesia's most populous island, and home to its capital

places.name: Bali
places.significance: Small island east of Java, Indonesia's main tourist destination

places.name: Borneo
places.significance: Third-largest island in the world, split between Indonesia, Malaysia and Brunei

places.name: Sulawesi
places.significance: K-shaped island east of Borneo

places.name: Dili
places.significance: Capital of Timor-Leste (East Timor)
notes: Timor-Leste shares the island of Timor with Indonesia's West Timor — its only land border

places.name: Kuala Lumpur
places.significance: Capital of Malaysia, on the peninsula

places.name: West Malaysia

places.name: Bandar Seri Begawan

places.name: Singapore

places.name: Manila

places.significance: Capital of Thailand

places.name: Vientiane

places.name: Laos
places.significance: The only landlocked country in South East Asia

places.name: Hanoi
places.significance: Capital of Vietnam

places.name: Phnom Penh
places.significance: Capital of Cambodia

places.name: Beijing
places.significance: Capital of China
